links.outcome: Accuracy on external TCGA cohort versus internal test data
links.effect: Internal macro-mean exact-match accuracy was 92.0%; on external TCGA cohort accuracy was 77.5%, rising to 88.0% after excluding structurally silent fields.
links.quote: On the external TCGA cohort, accuracy was 77.5%, rising to 88.0% after excluding structurally silent fields absent in older narratives.

links.outcome: Run-to-run reliability of LLM extraction across repeated runs
links.effect: Framework demonstrated near-perfect run-to-run reliability with 92.0% macro-mean exact-match accuracy on internal data.
links.quote: Using the gpt-oss-20b model, the framework achieved 92.0% macro-mean exact-match accuracy on internal data, demonstrating near-perfect run-to-run reliability.

unlisted_practices: Schema-first, CAP-aligned ontology with grammar-constrained decoding to structure LLM extraction
Local on-premises LLM deployment on a single 48 GB GPU for privacy preservation

screen.reason: Evaluates a locally deployed LLM framework using schema-constrained extraction (DSPy) for pathology abstraction against internal and TCGA datasets, but does not test a comparative deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
